General for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. M.C. Pant and Mr. D.S. Mehta, 
Advocate for respondent no. 3.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner 
contends that a settlement outside the 
conciliation proceedings arrived at between the 
management and trade union, which was not 
registered because of objection raised by the 
trade union, has been put to execution under 
Section 6H(1) of the Act, which is impermissible 
in view of the plain language of the said 
provision.
5. Per contra, learned counsel appearing for 
the trade union submits that the settlement 
arrived at between the parties was acted upon 
by the management, therefore, management 
cannot resile therefrom in respect of remaining 
employees. He further submits that mere non￾registration of the settlement will not have the 
effect of non-enforceability of the settlement.
6. List on 18.09.2025.
7. Interim order, if any, to continue till then. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
